local_qwen_lane.ownership: Each arm's durable ledgers/world state are isolated directories; native owners admit their own state. The adapter owns counts, raw model bytes, measured usage and timings; server owns transient inference state.
local_qwen_lane.authority: Explicit initialization/read/proposal ports only. Public world mutations require native/ordinary public dispatch. Model text cannot execute code or read files. Count-only preview cannot generate. Private evaluation requires both terminal.
local_qwen_lane.shape_versions: comparison-exchange/1 plus existing native response/operation schemas. Fixed MODEL revision and Limits. Serving schema reuse does not replace native admission. Unknown metrics stay null.
local_qwen_lane.identity_scope: Arm/request/payload hash bound before dispatch; source/document/hypothesis identities remain distinct. Same model weights/tokenizer hashes per serving receipt; no cross-arm request import.
local_qwen_lane.time_order: Predictions/proposals retained before action; preview is prospective, actual pending input counted again; generation and validation wall time separated from unmeasured GPU/energy.
local_qwen_lane.delivery_idempotency: Completed exact request replay returns retained envelope without inference. Conflicting request IDs, unresolved counting/generation and unknown outcomes block; no automatic retries.
local_qwen_lane.commit_recovery: SQLite states counting/prepared/generating/complete/blocked and raw bytes committed around network boundary. Uncertain completion never triggers another model/world dispatch.
local_qwen_lane.retention: All case requests, rejections, raw receipts and usage retained under finite limits; original expired/completed runs preserved; no claim of unbounded memory or crash qualification.
local_qwen_lane.resource_limits: Per arm64 decisions/128 exchanges/12288+4096 token caps/256 public calls/2097152 reservations/six-hour admission.4096 tokenizer count calls; bounded bytes/timeouts; two-T4 profile. GPU quota unverified.
local_qwen_lane.errors: Invalid/unsupported/oversize/unknown/expired conditions fail closed with retained artifacts. Missing reports/evaluation remain missing. Runtime failures are not model success.
local_qwen_lane.feedback_grounding: Current-arm public observations feed baseline notes or actual EDI processing, then model proposal and genuine broker outcome. Generated component results remain attributed; no solved Cedar answers or evaluator data enter participants.

public_receipt_view.ownership: Broker owns public receipts; common transport view reads only own-arm committed events and attempt statuses. Native/ordinary owners retain action authority. Exact rendered view retained in model ledger.
public_receipt_view.authority: SELECT operation,response FROM events and SELECT operation,status FROM attempts only. No state/identity/evaluator/other-arm read. No direct public mutation from view.
public_receipt_view.shape_versions: public-tool-binding/1.0; domains copied from public API; known-ID decoder enums supplement unchanged native/broker admission. submit recommendations and uncertainties are arrays.
public_receipt_view.identity_scope: Own-arm public document/source/person/stand namespaces kept separate from EDI record/hypothesis IDs. Observed IDs only; definite404 document removed.
public_receipt_view.time_order: Proposal intent and incremented decision visible before import. Committed broker failure visible before next native token preview; actual rendered request counted again.
public_receipt_view.delivery_idempotency: Completed exact request replay returns retained envelope without inference. Conflicting request IDs, unresolved counting/generation and unknown outcomes block; no automatic retries.
public_receipt_view.commit_recovery: View is bounded in-memory derivative; exact render and underlying events/proposals are durable. Driver supports fresh-only runs and blocks uncertain completion; no recovery/replay qualification.
public_receipt_view.retention: Full receipts preserved with native/ordinary owners. View contains bounded ID registry and9000-character latest receipt preview; no promise of full context.
public_receipt_view.resource_limits: Same64 decisions/128 exchanges/12288+4096/256 public calls/six hours per arm.512document/128stand/person registry,1 immediate operation. Eight synthetic model-gate calls outside participant totals.
public_receipt_view.errors: Definite rejected operation excluded at fixed public event cut;404read ID removed. New discovery permits reconsideration. Unknown dispatch blocks; no automatic retry.
public_receipt_view.feedback_grounding: Already received public data only, equal generic instructions and API binding both arms. No old Cedar policy/outcomes. Generated EDI records remain attributed, not new public observations.
